hero.name: Nguyen Duc Toan
hero.description: Front End Developer with hands-on experience in TypeScript, React, and Next.js, specializing in server-side rendering (SSR), SEO optimization, and modern caching strategies to build high-performance web applications.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about creating efficient, high-performance, and user-centric technology solutions.
about.narrativeP1: I graduated with a major in Information Technology from Thang Long University. With hands-on experience working at APUS Digital Solutions JSC and VNPT Cybersecurity Center, I focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and scalable web applications.
about.narrativeP2: My objective is to write clean, scalable software, applying modern rendering paradigms (SSR/SSG/ISR) and efficient caching layers (React Query/Redis) to deliver maximum value to end-users and organizations.
about.valueQualityDesc: Writing clear, structured, and easy-to-maintain source code.
about.valuePerformanceDesc: Ensuring lightning-fast page loads and robust SEO through server-side rendering.
about.highlightFrontendDesc: Proficient in React, Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and UI libraries like MUI.
about.highlightBackendDesc: Experience developing APIs and business logic with Node.js (Express) and Java (Spring Boot).
about.highlightDatabaseDesc: Optimizing MySQL, PostgreSQL databases, and API performance using Redis caching.
about.highlightSystemDesc: Managing source code with Git/GitHub and basic application dockerization.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: Key projects I have developed and contributed to recently.

items.project_1_desc: Developed HRM, order, and product management modules using Next.js, TypeScript, MUI, and React Hook Form. Integrated RESTful APIs and TanStack Query for real-time synchronization.
items.project_2_desc: An online shopping platform with a real-time shopping cart, Stripe integration, and a comprehensive admin control dashboard.
items.project_3_desc: Built backend API services for managing recruitment postings and blogs using ExpressJS. Integrated Redis caching layer for API performance optimization.
items.project_4_desc: An intuitive Kanban workspace with drag-and-drop task items and visualization graphs tracking team productivity.
